flowchart TD

| C | V 実装 merged | pr.merged = true | atlas.W | B |
| D | D 実装 merged | pr.merged = true | atlas.W2 | B |
| `E` | C と D の出口 | ci.rollup = SUCCESS | atlas.R | C, D |
| G | 検証 PASS | R の報告 | atlas.R | F |
